# Orbit — launch brief

Fictional demo data for OpenYak screenshots. Not a real company or release.

Orbit is a small collaborative workspace for product teams.

## Release snapshot

| Metric | Current | Previous |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Weekly active teams | 1,284 | 1,060 |
| Activation rate | 68% | 54% |
| Median time to first project | 4.2 min | 6.8 min |
| Support tickets | 32 | 47 |

## What shipped

- A shorter onboarding flow with a shared project template.
- Faster workspace search and keyboard navigation.
- Clearer invitation and permission controls.

## What to watch

- Mobile onboarding still takes longer than desktop.
- Two accessibility issues remain in the invitation flow.
- Keep the launch cohort small until both issues are resolved.

## Decision

Proceed with a limited rollout; monitor activation and support tickets for one week.
The adjacent dashboard.html visualizes this sample data, and is a hand-authored demo asset.
